tests.name: SentinelPath_WithInputPaths_UsesFirstInputParent
tests.description: Class and standalone execution derive a persistent sentinel beside the first input, including relative and nested .process inputs, while empty inputs use the repository root.
tests.arrange: Activities with absolute, relative, nested .process, multiple, and empty input path lists.
tests.act: Build prompts and execute class-based and standalone skill invocations.
tests.assert: The expected sentinel is read, stale state is removed before invocation, the replacement remains, returned paths match, and a missing sentinel raises SkillActivityError.

tests.name: FakeHarness_WithFirstInput_WritesColocatedPersistentSentinel
tests.description: The integration fake follows the same co-location and fallback rules as production.
tests.arrange: Prompts with a first input, no input, and different skills sharing one source parent.
tests.assert: It creates missing .process directories, writes co-located sentinels, retains root fallback, and distinct skill sentinels coexist.

tests.name: SkillContracts_AllSkillsRetainColocatedSentinels
tests.description: All skill instructions and verification scripts adopt the persistent co-located sentinel contract.
tests.arrange: All repository SKILL.md and verify.sh files plus the post-edit hook.
tests.act: Inspect the files with static contract tests and exercise representative verification dispatch.
tests.assert: Instructions require parent/.process creation and retention, verify scripts contain no deletion logic, and the hook accepts nested sentinel paths without consuming them.
